pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on sequential order stacking within 5 minutes on the same instrument unless floating profit exceeds 2.0x target stop-loss distance.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory Order Book Imbalance and ATR volatility normalization check; block entries if spread exceeds 0.35x current 14-period ATR.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressive scaling trigger at +$5.00 to +$8.00 profit to lock gains before mean-reversion wicks occur.
